svg.title: How to read a pump characteristic chart
svg.text: How to read a pump characteristic chart
NPSH required: dashed (ft); brake horsepower: dash-dot
Mark the capacity Q; go up to the head curve of the chosen impeller diameter; go across to read the head.
At the same point read the efficiency from the iso-efficiency loops, the NPSH required from the dashed lines
and the brake horsepower from the dash-dot lines (interpolate between lines).
Redrawn from Foust Fig. 21.17a (Goulds Pumps; digitized from the paper's copy,
approximate efficiency, NPSH and bhp lines); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
